subcategory_text: Define roles and responsibilities for each member of the software development team, including but not limited to development, security, operations, and quality assurance.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: PM-2, PS-2, SA-3
implementation_examples: Maintain a RACI matrix per project identifying who is responsible, accountable, consulted, and informed for security activities
Embed security champions within each development team
Document responsibilities in role descriptions and onboarding packs
assessment_objectives: Determine whether roles and responsibilities for software security are defined for all team members.
Determine whether security roles are embedded within development teams.
